observation_indicators.observable_fil: 1. Gumagamit ng magalang na tono at malinaw na tinutukoy ang hindi tatanggapin, ipapaskil o ipamimigay. 2. Itinutugma ang dahilan sa formula o prescription samples at inuulit ang hangganan nang walang workaround o pangakong exception. 3. Nagbibigay ng factual na handover sa natiyak na namamahala, kasama ang sariling tugon, walang datos ng pasyente.
observation_indicators.observable_en: 1. Uses a respectful tone and explicitly names what will not be accepted, displayed or distributed. 2. Matches the reason to formula or prescription samples and repeats the boundary without a workaround or promised exception. 3. Gives a factual handover to the confirmed supervisor, including their response, without patient data.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: 1. Malabo ang pagtanggi o tinatanggap pa rin ang mga bagay. 2. Maling polisiya ang gamit o pumapayag sa alternatibong promosyon. 3. Walang pag-ulat o haka-haka at personal na datos ang ulat.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: 1. Refusal is ambiguous or the items are still accepted. 2. Uses the wrong policy or agrees to alternative promotion. 3. Omits reporting or includes speculation and patient data.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Naipapakita ang tatlong kilos nang walang prompt: malinaw na pagtanggi, tamang dahilan/matatag na hangganan, factual na ulat.
levels.kaya_na_en: Demonstrates all three without prompting: clear refusal, accurate reason/firm boundary, factual report.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Tamang direksiyon ngunit kailangan ng prompt sa isa o higit pang kilos.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Correct direction but needs a prompt for one or more actions.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Tumatanggap, may workaround, maling dahilan, o walang factual na ulat.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Accepts, arranges a workaround, gives a wrong reason, or omits factual reporting.
